Implementation of the General Data
Protection Regulations (GDPR) in 2018
as well enactment of the Kenya Data
Protection Act 2019 continues to raise the
bar on data protection.
There are strong obligations placed on
data controllers and processors requiring
them to abide by principles of meaningful
user consent, collection limitation,
purpose limitation, data minimisation and
data security.
